channel.title: MC Joint — Music, Talent & Cinema
channel.description: News, projects and updates from MC Joint — Hyderabad's creative agency for music distribution, talent management and Telugu cinema strategy.

item.title: Pickpocket — A Telugu Film by Divya Bandaru | Avanti Cinema × MC Joint
item.description: Pickpocket (2022) is a Telugu film written and directed by Divya Bandaru, a tribute to Bresson. MC Joint was the marketing partner. Watch the full film, trailer and soundtrack.
item.dc:creator: MC Joint

item.title: Why Your IMDb Page Matters More Than You Think
item.description: Why an accurate IMDb profile matters for actors, directors, musicians and studios — and what ongoing maintenance involves.
item.dc:creator: MC Joint

item.title: Beyond Physical — Documentary Series by Prashanth Podagatlapalli | Flintstory × MC Joint
item.description: Beyond Physical is a documentary series produced by Flintstory and directed by Prashanth Podagatlapalli, exploring the discipline and philosophy behind parkour, boxing, BMX cycling, CrossFit and yoga. Five episodes shot across Hyderabad; currently in post-production.
item.dc:creator: MC Joint

item.title: Viral Video — Debut Feature Film by Prashanth Podagatlapalli | MC Joint
item.description: Viral Video is the debut directorial feature by writer-director Prashanth Podagatlapalli, currently in post-production. Cast: Pooja Bhavani, Feroze MNA, Laxman Meesala, Muni Myatari. Music: Ravi Nidamarthy. Editor: Rohit Penumatsa.
item.dc:creator: MC Joint

item.title: Gopi Galla Goa Trip — Avanti Cinema's Rural Telangana Road Comedy (2025)
item.description: Gopi Galla Goa Trip is a rural Telangana adventure-comedy directed by Rohit Penumatsa and Camp Sasi, starring Ajith Mohan as Gopi and featuring Raju Shivaratri and Pawon Ramesh. Produced by Avanti Cinema, represented by MC Joint.
item.dc:creator: MC Joint

item.title: Sheeshmahal — A Decade in the Making | Avanti Cinema × MC Joint
item.description: Sheeshmahal is a landmark Telugu film by Avanti Cinema, directed by Rohit Penumatsa and Camp Sasi with music by Vivek Sagar. A decade in the making, distributed and strategised by MC Joint.
item.dc:creator: MC Joint

item.title: Avanti Cinema — Six Years of Independent Telugu Storytelling | MC Joint
item.description: A retrospective on Avanti Cinema's journey — from Pickpocket to Sheeshmahal. Directed by Rohit Penumatsa and Camp Sasi. MC Joint's longest-standing creative partnership in Telugu independent cinema.
item.dc:creator: MC Joint

item.title: Nalgonda Gaddar Narsanna — The Voice That Crossed Every Stage in 2023
item.description: Nalgonda Gaddar Narsanna's folk songs resonated across both Telugu states during the 2023 elections — lending his voice to all parties alike. Represented by MC Joint since late 2021.
item.dc:creator: MC Joint
